NONE_q_mask_geometry_summary.limitations: Predicted SAM3 mask width proxy only; neither anatomical fish width nor true foreground-depth accuracy. Only q38 masks decoded; no GT or sensor pixels reopened.

scope: All1471 sealed observation rows/39208 object-frames and all P1/P2 event evidence; only38 current prediction masks decoded at19 q. No sensor/RGB/GT pixels reopened, no replay, inference, service, API, threshold change or frozen-file writes.

semantics.cohort_priority: retained if usable; otherwise inferred if usable; otherwise NONE. Full exclusive7x7 eroded core remains denominator; spatial cohort medians never mixed.
semantics.eligibility: n>=16; valid_fraction>=.2; positive median; finite nonnegative actualMAD; max(15,1.4826*actualMAD)<=60. Area<16 is structurally impossible.
semantics.actual_MAD: cohorts.retained.mad and cohorts.inferred.mad remain median absolute deviation of their saved current pixel-value cohorts. Raw objects.core.mad is actualMAD too.
semantics.inferred_noise_adapter: core.mad for selected inferred is max(actualMAD,60/1.4826)=40.46944556859571 here. All767 selected inferred entries are raised. This deliberately carries an assumed60mm noise floor through the old DS1 mad interface, not a measured40.469mm dispersion.
semantics.history_noise_adapter: depth_frozen.samples[].mad_mm inherits selected core adapter; predict uses sigma=max(15,1.4826*mad_mm) and WLS inverse-variance weighting. Raw source-specific cohort MAD remains available via fact_id. Do not label history mad_mm as direct empirical MAD when inferred.
semantics.history_qualification: Only SOURCE_OBSERVATION/RESTORED_POST with core_usable enters contiguous source history; quality/contact/group/pending observations break current fragment. Freeze latest single same generation/public/epoch fragment within pre-suspect30 frames; use last10. No history gives nullforecast; 1-2 samples give LAST_VALUE, >=3 gives WLS when valid time span.
semantics.q_balancing: Both current post cores must be usable before either row contributes. Missing forecast makes that role row common zero information for both sources; available role row may still contribute. Acceptance requires depth_best==total_best and gap>=log9.
semantics.point_vs_temporal_sample: More valid pixels in masks does not increase temporal history sample count unless the source update is individually admissible, survives fragment/version gates, and is selected in pre-q frozen history.
semantics.post_NONE_median: NONE core copies retained statistics for diagnostics. Non-null median does not make it admissible; core_usable remains false.

recommended_next.target: Current prediction-mask foreground/background extraction under narrow/contact masks, not more saved completion alone.
recommended_next.minimal_diagnostic: Use the frozen same q/controls; compare fixed7x7 core with distance-transform center regions whose boundary margin scales with the current mask only. Retain raw/retained/inferred cohort separation and explicit boundary-excluded control; do not select geometry using GT or relax identity acceptance from these posthoc cases.
recommended_next.admission_checks: Record source-specific actualMAD and independent assumed noise scale as separate fields in a new experiment; test n/fraction and boundary/contact support before claiming fish-surface reliability. Keep DS7 code/seals untouched.
recommended_next.unknown: Current mask membership does not identify true fish-surface depth; physical true depth, foreground accuracy and effects of any adaptive geometry remain unmeasured.
